name: mcp
description: Self-hosted MCP servers with fail-closed network and database boundaries: guarded Fetch, true read-only SQLite, and timezone conversion

capabilities.name: mcp.fetch
capabilities.description: Fetch public HTTP(S) content as markdown or raw text with bounded reads, DNS/IP validation, private/metadata target blocking, and redirect revalidation (secure_fetch_mcp.py)

capabilities.name: mcp.sqlite
capabilities.description: SQLite query and schema inspection using URI mode=ro, PRAGMA query_only, and a deny-by-default write authorizer; optional execute requires explicit writable mode

capabilities.name: mcp.time
capabilities.description: Get current time in a timezone and convert times between timezones with DST gap/fold handling

health_checks.description: Verify secure Fetch, SQLite, and Time MCP server modules import

storage.description: Default SQLite database inspected by sqlite_mcp; read-only mode never creates or mutates the file
